name: Something's In The Air
source:
You are a single American guy who moved to a new city a few weeks ago for work.

Your social circle consists of a couple of guys from work, and Dave an old friend from your home town who moved here before you. Between work and getting settled, you have not had much of a chance to get a social life going. 

So far all you have done is join a gym and go on one date with a girl named Ariane, and that was over a week ago.

You are determined that on your next day off work, you are going to go meet new people. Especially female people... 
or at least ask Ariane out again.

It's a beautiful Saturday morning in the middle of summer.  Now is your chance!

Join the romantic comedy adventure and make your own decisions, leading to over 25 different endings.

Something's In The Air is unrated and contains the equivalent of R rated material (language, nudity, non graphic sexual situations) that may not be appropriate for all players.  Must be over 18 to download and play.

[From [url=http://arianeb.com/sita/index.htm]official site[/url]]
translation:
你是一名单身美国男子，几周前为了工作搬到一座新城市。

你的社交圈只有几位同事，以及老家朋友戴夫，他比你更早搬到这里。忙着工作和安顿生活，你几乎还没有机会展开社交。

目前，你只办了健身房会员，和一位名叫阿丽安的女孩约会过一次，而且那已经是一周多以前的事了。

你打定主意，下一个休息日一定要出去认识新朋友，尤其是女性…
或者至少，再次约阿丽安出门。

盛夏一个美丽的星期六早晨，正是你的机会！

加入这场浪漫喜剧冒险，亲自作出决定，走向超过二十五种不同的结局。

《空气中的情愫》尚未分级，包含相当于R级的内容，如粗俗语言、裸露及非露骨的性场景，可能并不适合所有玩家。须年满十八岁才可下载游玩。
